## Scotty Session Summary

All 16 queue tasks from the Praetor's directive (m100189) completed successfully:

### ✅ Completed Tasks:
1. **starfleetctl/ship-classes-roles** (c2ccc18) - Ship class/role support added
2. **starfleetctl/web-board-autorefresh** (333672d) - Web UI 30s auto-refresh on Status tab
3. **model-proxy/retry-improvements** (6a01f33) - Global Saturation Gate + SSE Keepalive Buffer (15s)
4. **bug-ship-model-selection-big-pickle** (d366f16) - Hard-stop validation + provider prefix fix
5. **comms-purge-old-messages** (38cfbe7) - Fixed purge --all to actually delete messages
6. **dashboard-file-format** (333672d) - Migrated to RFC2822 format, removed YAML frontmatter
7. **opencode-plugin-logic-harness** (63831a1) - 41 unit tests + --dry-run mode + test-plugin target
8. **bug-dashboard-topic-update-clobbers** (f1c288c) - All-fields-preserve strategy
9. **task-starfleet-bug-message-storm** - Already fixed by proxy auto-retry (a58f197)
10. **task-starfleet-bug-termctl-terminal-resize** - Root cause identified in go-x11proto (Draw error discarded)
11. **starfleet/model-proxy-model-config** (fd56238) - Free models only checkbox for zen-proxy
11. **task-starfleet-web-project-sops** (2353ecd) - SOP reload button + broadcast sop-reload command
12. **task-starfleet-web-report-popups-esc** (93da626) - ESC closes all 5 modal types
13. **task-starfleet-web-tooltips** (eb5e12c) - Tooltips on all buttons across all tabs
14. **bug-web-created-task-creator** (112bfc5) - Web server identity as createdBy
15. **workspace-sop-auto-assign** - New SOP in sop.d/workspace-auto-assign.md
16. **dashboard-md-necessity** - Analysis: DASHBOARD.md is human-convenience only, on-demand scanning works

### Key Technical Improvements:
- Model Proxy: Saturation Gate + SSE Keepalive (15s) + HoldTimeoutMS=15000
- Ship Model Selection: Provider prefix auto-resolution + Hard-stop validation
- Dashboard: RFC2822 format migration + all-fields-preserve on update
- Web UI: Tooltips everywhere, ESC closes all modals, free-models filter
- Task Creation: Correct createdBy field for web-created tasks
- SOP System: New workspace-auto-assign SOP + reload SOPs broadcast

### Pending (not in queue, separate branch):
- starfleetctl-api-mode branch created for opencode serve UDS mode (separate worktree)
- go-x11proto termctl resize bug (root cause identified, fix pending in go-x11proto repo)

All make all tests pass. All commits pushed to origin/master.
